responsibility: Contains the instruction scheduling model for Intel Core 2 and related Nehalem-class processors in the i386 backend. It defines decoder and execution-port automata, domain attributes, irregular instruction reservations, and detailed latency/throughput descriptions for integer, x87, MMX, SSE, divide, and memory forms, allowing GCC’s scheduler to approximate these out-of-order Intel cores separately from Atom, Pentium-family, or AMD scheduling files.
